prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of SELENE. Long-winged gold-crowned Selene sweeping diagonally across night in a two-white-horse chariot.
ANATOMY: ONE kindly but commanding woman with one head, two eyes, two human arms, two legs, TWO long feathered wings extending from her back and a broad GOLD DIADEM. Fully opaque long ivory Greek robe. Exactly TWO white horses pull the chariot, no horse wings. This is the documented winged Homeric-hymn variant, not the wingless art variant. [selene-c23, selene-c33, selene-c27, selene-c25]
MOMENT: Sweep the chariot diagonally past the near viewer, upper body turned back toward us with a commanding gaze, hands actively pulling reins. Her two immense wings spread on different planes and long robe trails from the moving chariot.
POWER: Traverse the celestial night as personification of the moon; a real lunar disc shines behind the raised wing, actual moonlight makes gold crown and feathers tactile. No magic attack or wing-generated ribbons. [selene-c01, selene-c02, selene-c33]
SCALE & CAMERA: Full wing-span diagonal three-quarter composition from low at the chariot flank; goddess large in upper foreground, complete two-white-horse team clear across lower diagonal. Composition radically different from frontal portrait.
LIGHT & WEATHER: Single cold silver moon source with subtle warm gold reflection on the diadem, deep night shadows.
SURFACE: rich tactile cloth, fur, scales or stone appropriate to the specified anatomy, wet water surfaces and physical dust only where mentioned.
SETTING: Night sky during the chariot's passage, a few tiny stars secondary to her silhouette. [selene-c02, selene-c33]
MOOD: imposing, overwhelming, awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the source; figure and identifying features instantly legible at 200 pixels; never cute, calm, decorative or an ordinary person or animal.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: ONE square image, premium painterly cinematic illustration with tactile brushwork rather than glossy photoreal fashion rendering; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame, watermark, nudity, gore, extra heads, limbs, fingers or duplicated anatomy; no film, game, anime or comic design, no neon outline, generic glow aura, magic ribbons or floating runes. Every effect must belong to the cited deed; environmental lighting is artistic presentation.
depicted_variant: Long-winged gold-crowned Selene sweeping diagonally across night in a two-white-horse chariot.

visual_requirements.description: Hymnic variant: woman with long wings, gold diadem and long robe, with two white unwinged horses.
Moon goddess in an active celestial chariot journey; moonlight, no energy attack.

selection_reason: Varian A dipilih karena mahkota bulan sabit dan tatapan frontal rendah langsung mengenali dewi bulan pada thumbnail; varian B hymnic bersayap merupakan komposisi diagonal berbeda dan tetap dipertahankan.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli dilihat: varian sayap panjang dua buah dan mahkota emas, sosok berjubah dengan dua tangan menarik reins, dua kuda putih tanpa sayap dalam komposisi diagonal. Langit malam/bulan dan sayap membentuk siluet ilahi; turning gaze dan kuda bergerak. Figur ornamental kecil pada kereta adalah ukiran editorial bukan tokoh tambahan/efek. Tidak ada teks, aura rekaan atau anatomi tambahan. Uji Sangar lolos.
